Keiynan Lonsdale (The Flash) | Hyperfixated with Joseph Shepherd #14
recentItems.description:
Actor, musician, and The Flash star Keiynan Lonsdale joins Joseph Shepherd to chat about growing up obsessed with Michael Jackson, accidentally discovering his love of acting through Fame, his creative process as a musician, and the journey behind his new song “Body High.” Plus, performing on stage, terrible bike dates, Drag Race, sexual awakenings, Pop the Balloon, and so much more.

Thanks for watching Hyperfixated! Love you all.

recentItems.title: Ashley Rickards on Growing up Awkward
Ashley Rickards (Awkward) | Hyperfixated with Joseph Shepherd #13
recentItems.description:
Actress and Awkward star Ashley Rickards joins Joseph Shepherd to chat about growing up alongside Jenna Hamilton, the lasting legacy of Awkward, playing an autistic character in Fly Away, and what it was like saying goodbye to the show that became her family. Plus, One Tree Hill, frogs, growing up in Hollywood, moving away from Los Angeles, South Park, and so much more.

Thanks for watching Hyperfixated! Love you all.
